programLabels.zh-Hans: PHI OS 现实导航养成

en.summary: Learn to distinguish observations, reports, inferences and unknowns while preserving source lineage.

objectives.title: Separate evidence classes
objectives.statement: Distinguish observation, report and inference in a bounded learning scenario.

objectives.title: Preserve source and lineage
objectives.statement: Preserve source, uncertainty and lineage boundaries when explaining evidence.

zh-Hans.summary: 学习区分观察、报告、推断与未知，同时保留来源谱系。

objectives.title: 区分证据类别
objectives.statement: 在有边界的学习情境中区分观察、报告与推断。

objectives.title: 保留来源与谱系
objectives.statement: 解释证据时，保留来源、不确定性与谱系边界。

en.summary: Form a reading that keeps evidence, uncertainty, limits and competing interpretations visible.

objectives.title: Bound reading claims
objectives.statement: Bound each reading claim to the governed evidence that supports it.

objectives.title: Preserve reading limits
objectives.statement: Preserve uncertainty, limitations and competing interpretations in a bounded reading.

zh-Hans.summary: 形成一种能够持续显示证据、不确定性、限制与竞争性解释的解读。

objectives.title: 限定解读主张
objectives.statement: 把每项解读主张限定在支持它的受治理证据范围内。

objectives.title: 保留解读限制
objectives.statement: 在有边界的解读中保留不确定性、限制与竞争性解释。

en.summary: Map options and constraints without silently choosing an action or exceeding declared authority.

objectives.title: Map options and constraints
objectives.statement: Map material options and constraints without silently selecting an action.

objectives.title: Bound navigation authority
objectives.statement: Bound a proposed action to the learner's declared authority and constraint conditions.

zh-Hans.summary: 在不静默选择行动、也不超越已声明权限的前提下，映射选项与约束。

objectives.title: 映射选项与约束
objectives.statement: 映射实质性选项与约束，而不静默选择行动。

objectives.title: 限定导航权限
objectives.statement: 把拟议行动限定在学习者声明的权限与约束条件内。

en.summary: Review actions and observed outcomes while preserving uncertainty and continuation lineage.

objectives.title: Link action and outcome
objectives.statement: Link an action, its observed outcome and unresolved uncertainty during review.

objectives.title: Preserve continuation lineage
objectives.statement: Preserve evidence, decision and revision lineage when forming a continuation state.

zh-Hans.summary: 回顾行动与观察到的结果，同时保留不确定性及延续谱系。

objectives.title: 连接行动与结果
objectives.statement: 回顾时连接行动、观察到的结果及尚未解决的不确定性。

objectives.title: 保留延续谱系
objectives.statement: 形成延续状态时，保留证据、决定与修订谱系。

en.summary: Practise professional, jurisdictional, credential and entitlement boundaries without creating professional authority.

objectives.title: Apply professional boundaries
objectives.statement: Apply professional, jurisdictional and assignment boundaries to an advanced learning scenario.

objectives.title: Separate credential and entitlement
objectives.statement: Separate Learning Capability, Credential, Entitlement and Professional authority in a governed scenario.

zh-Hans.summary: 练习专业、司法管辖、凭证与权限边界，同时不建立专业权威。

objectives.title: 应用专业边界
objectives.statement: 在高级学习情境中应用专业、司法管辖与委派边界。

objectives.title: 区分凭证与权限
objectives.statement: 在受治理情境中区分学习能力、凭证、权限与专业权威。
